scripts.dev:be: uv run --directory backend fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.dev:be:https: uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --port 8443 --ssl-keyfile certs/key.pem --ssl-certfile certs/cert.pem
scripts.check:be: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend pytest -q
scripts.check:fe: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run check:be && npm run check:fe
